name: How long does a typical door hinge repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical door hinge repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to repair a door hinge depends on the complexity of the issue. Simple repairs, like tightening screws or lubricating a squeaky hinge, can often be completed in less than 30 minutes. More involved repairs, such as reinforcing stripped screw holes, correcting significant door misalignment, or replacing multiple hinges, might take 1 to 2 hours. Our technicians evaluate the problem on-site to provide an estimated timeframe. Factors like the type of door and hinge can also influence the duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple hinge repairs take under 30 minutes; more complex issues like stripped screws or misalignment can take 1-2 hours.
